build_requirements.envelope: MVP allowed envelope only (amendment §10): operator-driven, local host, single-tenant, operator-trusted input. H-12 hard-blocks external use.
build_requirements.f59: one-shot ticket enforcement active on every dispatch
build_requirements.observer_boundary: the E3 record is written to the observer's own output root and presented to the evaluator together with that recorder identity (m-3 r4 §3.6); an agent-supplied record is non_applicable(observer-mismatch)
build_requirements.tool_dispatch_constant: the operator-ratified fixed 8-name tool-dispatch constant, served by exact-set equality (F55)

capture_requirements: governed reads of ho1-rel-1 and ho1-rel-2, each resolving committed at the protocol grain
the conductor E1/E2 evidence for both records

clock.rule: every timestamp-bearing record takes epoch_start + (tick_ms * ordinal); no ambient wall clock is read

workspace_root.rule: created fresh per run; absolute path supplied at `run start`; workspace_root_id = lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the NFC-normalized realpath (m-10 producer-delta §5 recipe)

drive.note: the response/ack, carrying the lineage reference to ho1-rel-1

expected_shape.composite: the proof binds the conductor E1/E2 evidence for BOTH records; one stamped record alone does not satisfy this leg
expected_shape.member_spelling_note: the exact spelling of the parent/reference member is m-2's owned schema; this record fixes the SEMANTIC requirement (a resolvable reference to record 1's relay_id) and names m-2 as the owner-fidelity boundary that confirms the member name. It is deliberately not invented here.

record_2.lineage: a parent/reference member resolving to record 1's relay_id

fault.cut_definition: A negative-control submission in which seat-b attempts to author a record presenting seat-a as its sender. The fixture asserts the committed record's channel-stamped FROM remains seat-b regardless of what the caller supplied, so the forgery attempt is visible rather than effective.

negative_controls: the second record stamped with the originating seat's FROM => FAIL
a response carrying no resolvable reference to record 1 => FAIL
either record resolving unavailable => verdict unknown and the leg HOLDS, never a pass
objective: Two correctly-stamped records with lineage: the handoff relay stamped FROM the originating seat, and the second seat's response stamped FROM the second seat carrying a parent/reference to the first record's relay_id.

run_setup.channel_stamping: each authoring seat is on its own channel, so the origin FROM is never forged onto a second-seat record; the stamp is applied by the conductor, not carried by the caller
